subject: Post-call: Token Runway & Invoice Framework (pilot sizing)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany@novahealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Token Runway & Invoice Framework (pilot sizing)

Hi Bethany — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and the numbers we discussed so we have alignment before I put together a formal pilot quote. Attaching the token model workbook and a one‑page invoice sketch.

Call recap (TL;DR)
- Pilot scope: Proof-of-value for NovaHealth conversational triage flows (5 intents, ~3-4 turns/session).
- Expected traffic for pilot: ~300–400 active sessions/day; median session ~650 tokens (prompt + response).
- Preferred timeline: 6–8 week pilot, goal to validate latency and per-interaction unit economics.

Preliminary sizing we used on the call (assumptions in workbook)
- Pilot monthly tokens (approx): 300 sessions/day * 30 days * 650 tokens = ~5.85M tokens/mo (round to 6M)
- Target production runway (12 months): scale bands at 50M / 200M / 1B tokens/mo
- Cost levers: batching + prefix cache + lighter quantized model variant for background tasks

Unit economics band we talked through
- Estimated token cost (hosted Redwood baseline, before discounts): $1,100 per 1M tokens (this includes model + infra + platform margins)
- Target NovaHealth ask: goal to get to ~$700–900 per 1M at scale (via reserved/dedicated pricing and caching)

Next steps / asks for you (fast)
1) Confirm pilot target: do you want us to size a 6M/mo pilot or should we quote a conservative 10M/mo band for buffer?
2) Confirm whether procurement needs a formal SOW + PO during pilot (procure@novahealth.ai?).
3) Any constraints on data retention or egress we should bake into the quote?

Attachments: nova_pilot_token_model.xlsx (token assumptions + per-call calc), redwood_invoice_sketch.pdf (one-pager).

I can turn this into a formal pilot invoice and PO-ready PDF once you confirm the pilot band. Happy to hop on a quick 20-min follow-up tomorrow as well.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Dylan.Brooks@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Bethany Cole <bethany@novahealth.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@novahealth.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 17:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Token Runway & Invoice Framework (pilot sizing)

Thanks, Dylan — good summary. A couple of clarifying items before we finalize the band: 

- Does the $1,100 / 1M include cross-region egress and any storage for logs (we typically keep 30 days of interaction logs)? If not, can you show a line item for those?
- Can the token model workbook show a version with and without prefix caching? Our engineers want to understand delta in $/1M with cache hit rates at 20% vs 60%.
- Procurement: please send the invoice sketch to procure@novahealth.ai and copy me. They prefer a standard SOW + net30 PO for pilots.

Also looping in procurement contact: procurement lead is Tom Reyes (procure@novahealth.ai).

If you can provide a 2-line pilot estimate (pilot band and an escalator if we hit >50M/mo) I’ll route to finance.

Best,
Bethany Cole
Director of Platform Engineering
NovaHealth
bethany@novahealth.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call: Token Runway & Invoice Framework (pilot sizing)

Looping internally — drafting the numbers Bethany asked for. My quick notes (please sanity-check before I send updated attachments):

Assumptions we should show in the workbook:
- Baseline model cost (hosted): $0.0000011 per token => $1,100 / 1M
- Dedicated reserved discount (20–35%) depending on committed volume/band and term
- Caching scenarios:
  - No cache: baseline token count applies
  - 20% cache hit: effective tokens billed = tokens * 0.80
  - 60% cache hit: effective tokens billed = tokens * 0.40 (accounting for some repeated prefixes)
- Egress/storage: add $0.02 / GB for logs; estimate 1 GB per 250k tokens as a conservative heuristic (we'll caveat).

Proposed two-line pilot estimate to send to procurement (rounded for PO simplicity):
- Pilot (12 week) – conservative band: 10M tokens/mo => unit price shown at $1,000 / 1M => monthly pilot estimate: $10,000
- Pilot (12 week) – with caching (40% effective reduction): 10M tokens equivalent => effective billed tokens 6M => effective monthly charge: $6,000

Production escalator examples (for finance):
- 50M/mo band: $850 / 1M (reserved 12-mo commit)
- 200M/mo band: $780 / 1M (higher commit + cache)
- 1B/mo band: $650 / 1M (enterprise reserved pricing + custom quantization)
I attached internal_pricing_notes.xlsx with the detailed per-token lines and the cache model table. If you want I can produce two PDFs: one PO-ready and one that shows the detailed math.

Marissa
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany@novahealth.ai>, procure@novahealth.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Token Runway & Invoice Framework (pilot sizing)

Bethany / Tom — thanks for the quick read. I’ve attached a concise 2-line pilot invoice sketch (redwood_invoice_sketch.pdf) and an updated token model that includes both cache scenarios (nova_pilot_token_model.xlsx v2). Key points below so your finance team can move quickly: 

- Pilot ask: we recommend quoting a 10M/mo pilot band for PO simplicity (covers traffic spikes).
- Pilot invoice (example):
  - Service: Redwood Hosted Inference (pilot) — 10M billed tokens @ $1,000 per 1M = $10,000/mo
  - Optional: cache-optimized estimate (illustrative) — 10M tokens with 40% cache => billed 6M @ $1,000 = $6,000/mo
  - Egress/logging: estimated $25/mo (line item, adjustable to actuals)

I’ll send the PO-ready PDF to procure@novahealth.ai in a separate email and can add an SOW if that’s easier for Tom. If it helps, I can join your finance/procurement call tomorrow at 11am PT to walk through the invoice.

Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cInvoiceSketch (invoice sketch)

Thanks — I’ll wait for confirmation on pilot band and PO preference and will route the SOW + PO package once confirmed.

Dylan
